headlines.title_zh: 英伟达内部权力架构调整与接班人选博弈
headlines.title_en: Sources: Jensen Huang's daughter Madison, a marketing director, helped steer Nvidia's response to Megaspeed scrutiny and temporarily sidelined a top comms exec (Financial Times)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 英伟达高层因CEO黄仁勋离职及相关合规调查引发权力真空，其女Madison Huang在市场营销端的权力扩张引发内部关注
headlines.event_summary_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has departed following a scandal involving extramarital affairs and a board investigation into potential foreign intelligence targeting, creating a leadership vacuum. Madison Huang, Senior Director of Product Marketing for physical AI, has seen her internal influence surge, actively participating in critical decision-making regarding Megaspeed scrutiny and personnel changes within the communications division.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】黄仁勋（前首席执行官）、Madison Huang（物理AI产品营销高级总监）在英伟达公司总部与董事会调查程序：董事会对CEO展开合规调查，导致其离职及管理层重组，Madison Huang被指介入危机公关与人事清洗
【起因与机理】CEO面临道德丑闻及外国情报渗透风险，公司正处于技术路线转向与权力交接的关键节点
【调查与监管诉求】核心涉案：黄仁勋因道德风险及外部情报调查被迫离职，董事会启动继任者甄选。
【涉及范围与推进】后续节点：公司目前面临管理架构重组的迫切压力，家族成员及现任高层的职权划分将是未来经营稳定的关键。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Jensen Huang (Former CEO), Madison Huang (Senior Director of Product Marketing for Physical AI): Board probe into CEO conduct leading to resignation and management restructuring; Madison Huang implicated in crisis communications and personnel management
[Root Cause & Mechanism] CEO faced ethical scandals and potential foreign intelligence targeting amidst critical technical transition
[Key Metrics] According to Nvidia's annual filing, she took home $1.
[Key Position & Outlook] Outlook: Reorganization of leadership structure is imminent, with family involvement vs. professional management remaining a core tension.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 黄仁勋离职引发的权力真空标志着英伟达从创始人绝对集权向家族与专业经理人混合治理模式的转型，此类管理层动荡极易引发华尔街对公司透明度与技术路线稳定性的质疑。在物理AI与全球基础设施扩张的关键窗口期，管理层的派系斗争与合规整改可能延缓公司应对地缘监管及新一代计算架构的部署节奏。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Jensen Huang's departure marks a volatile transition from founder-led dominance to an uncertain governance structure, heightening market skepticism regarding leadership stability and corporate transparency. The internal friction amid a critical expansion into physical AI and global infrastructure risks stalling NVIDIA's momentum in navigating complex geopolitical compliance and next-gen computing R&D.

headlines.title_zh: Uber与Zipline联手启动无人机送餐
headlines.title_en: Uber and Zipline launch autonomous drone deliveries, starting with Uber Eats customers in Spring, Texas, with plans for 1M deliveries per day by the end of 2029 (Kirsten Korosec/TechCrunch)
headlines.event_summary_zh: Uber Eats与Zipline在得克萨斯州启动自动无人机配送服务，计划2029年底实现日均百万单规模
headlines.event_summary_en: Uber Eats and autonomous drone startup Zipline have launched commercial drone delivery in Spring, Texas. Utilizing long-range drones flying at 300 feet and speeds up to 70 mph to drop 8-pound orders via tether, the partnership aims to redefine U.S. last-mile logistics by reducing road traffic and operational latency.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Uber Eats、Zipline（CEO凯勒·克利夫顿）在美国得克萨斯州Spring市：启动无人机送餐服务，计划2029年底达日均100万单
【起因与机理】降低配送成本，寻求末端物流规模化效应
【商业与财务细节】Uber与Zipline达成商业配送战略联盟。
【各方立场与态度】设定2029年日均百万单的极高增长目标。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Uber Eats, Zipline (CEO Keller Cliffton) (Spring, Texas, USA): Launched drone delivery service with a target of 1 million daily deliveries by end-of-2029
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Scaling last-mile logistics and reducing operational overhead
[Key Metrics] Neither company has disclosed the investment amount, but Zipline announced last week it had raised $1.
[Key Position & Outlook] Targeting a massive scale of 1 million deliveries per day by 2029.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 无人机物流正从试验田走向存量市场博弈，核心挑战在于人口密集区的空域监管与噪声投诉压力。此举显示科技巨头正试图通过技术降维打击传统快递成本结构，但需突破城市法规和公众隐私红线的合规瓶颈。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Drone logistics is transitioning from niche trials to competitive market expansion, with operational success hinges on overcoming urban airspace regulation and community noise concerns. This move underscores a push to disrupt legacy courier cost structures via automation, pending rigorous compliance with privacy and safety mandates.

titans.name: Aravind Srinivas
titans.event_context_zh:
落和其他物体，到达挑战者深渊，一路上浏览 18 个发现。

屏幕上的所有内容都是代码。 Teammate 自己编写了 WebGPU 渲染器，没有游戏引擎，也没有 Three.js，并且无需导入任何模型、纹理或音频文件即可生成地形、海藻、生物、潜艇和声音。所有内容都包含在一个 373 KB HTML 文件中。

Ultra Effort 上有 36,000 个 Perplexity 积分（Fable 5.2 High 作为协调器）。
titans.event_context_en: Teammate on Fable 5.2 made HADAL, a dive into the Mariana Trench you can play in a browser tab at https://t.co/wgZHPEaeR
titans.quote_zh:
《神鬼寓言 5.2》中的队友制作了《HADAL》，这是一款潜入马里亚纳海沟的游戏，您可以在浏览器选项卡中玩 。你首先是一名水肺潜水员，在阳光明媚的珊瑚礁上，登上一艘潜艇，一路向下经过沉船、鲸鱼坠落和其他物体，到达挑战者深渊，一路上浏览 18 个发现。

屏幕上的所有内容都是代码。 Teammate 自己编写了 WebGPU 渲染器，没有游戏引擎，也没有 Three.js，并且无需导入任何模型、纹理或音频文件即可生成地形、海藻、生物、潜艇和声音。所有内容都包含在一个 373 KB HTML 文件中。

Ultra Effort 上有 36,000 个 Perplexity 积分（Fable 5.2 High 作为协调器）。
titans.quote_en:
Teammate on Fable 5.2 made HADAL, a dive into the Mariana Trench you can play in a browser tab at https://t.co/wgZHPEaeRy. You start as a scuba diver on a sunlit reef, board a submarine, and work your way down past shipwrecks, a whale fall and other things to Challenger Deep, scanning 18 discoveries as you go.

Everything on screen is code. Teammate wrote the WebGPU renderer itself, with no game engine and no Three.js, and generated the terrain, kelp, creatures, submarine and sound without a single imported model, texture or audio file. It all fits in one 373 KB HTML file.

36,000 Perplexity credits on Ultra Effort (Fable 5.2 High as orchestrator).

tool_item.pain_point_zh: 编码代理自主生成代码时常不自觉引入反序列化、注入或权限绕过漏洞，传统人工审计耗时且容易遗漏隐蔽攻击面。

机器可读结构化报告：输出格式化安全审计建议，允许代理根据报错自动自愈重构
零云端数据外泄：在本地隔离环境中执行规则检测，保障企业专有代码私密安全
key_features_en: Multi-Phase Independent Verification: Executes threat modeling, taint analysis, and boundary audits on diffs
Machine-Readable Audit Evals: Formats findings so coding agents can self-heal vulnerabilities automatically
Zero Cloud Data Leakage: Runs locally sandboxed rule matching to guarantee proprietary code privacy
